name: Alistair MacLeod
bio:
Alistair's precision and attention to detail were evident from a young age, traits honed during his apprenticeship at a local engineering firm. Inspired by the technical ingenuity displayed in Formula 1, he transitioned into motorsport, initially as a junior technician. His meticulous nature quickly led him to focus on quality control, where he excels at identifying and rectifying potential issues before they impact performance. 

Alistair believes that a robust quality control system is the bedrock of any successful racing team. He approaches his work with an unwavering focus on standards, constantly seeking ways to improve processes and ensure the highest levels of reliability. While still developing his leadership skills, his methodical approach and drive for perfection make him a valuable asset.

Away from the track, Alistair is an avid hill walker, finding solace and clarity in the rugged Scottish landscape. This passion for nature reinforces his appreciation for precision and the interconnectedness of systems – qualities he brings to his work in motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Alistair is of average height with a slightly wiry build, reflecting his active lifestyle.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of meticulously cleaning his workspace, even after others have used it.
Often seen sketching diagrams or flowcharts during team meetings.
